narrative.overview:
A light, grouped interface in the manner of Apple's own settings and forms. Nothing is dark: a translucent white header floats over a grouped grey page (#F2F2F7), and the work sits on soft white panels with generous 16px corners and a faint shadow instead of a border. Inside, fields are filled rather than outlined, sections are separated by hairlines rather than boxed, and items such as uploads, signatures and summaries sit on soft grey tiles. The system font (SF Pro on Apple devices, Geist as a fallback) carries the whole hierarchy in near-black.

There is one accent, a clinical teal, and it means "act here" or "you are here": primary buttons, links, the focused field's edge and halo, the current step, the current tab underline, progress. Approval is a true green. Problems are red and burnt orange, and "in review" is a soft indigo. There are no per-module colours; modules are told apart by icon and name. Status is always icon + label + colour.

Density stays comfortable: 15px input text in 44px fields, 13px medium labels, 32px between sections, and one sticky footer that always holds the next action at bottom right. Motion is short and state-led: steps rise into place, checks pop, notes fade in, and all of it stops under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: No dark surfaces: a translucent white header with a hairline, a grouped grey page, white panels.
Soft panels: 16px corners and a faint two-layer shadow, no border.
Filled inputs: tertiary grey fill at rest, white with a teal edge and 4px teal halo on focus, a red tint when invalid.
Hairline-divided sections, never boxed; items sit on soft 12px grey tiles.
One teal accent; approval green; red and orange for problems; soft indigo for review.
System font in near-black, with labels at 13px medium.
Red is earned: it appears only for issues the provider has already walked past, or for HR rejections.

rules.name: The Earned Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks a step only after the provider opened it and moved on with required fields empty, or when HR rejected the module or an item. Untouched required work is neutral ("N to complete", grey circle), never red.

rules.name: The Pending Is Work Rule
rules.body: A document waiting for signature is neutral work ("Ready to sign" in teal), not a problem. It turns red only when the document is rejected or voided.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent and means act here or you are here. There is no per-module colour; a module is identified by its icon and name. Green, red, orange and indigo are status-only.

rules.name: The Approved Is Green Rule
rules.body: Approval uses the true green, never the teal, so "done" never reads as "current".

rules.name: The No Dark Surfaces Rule
rules.body: No dark bands, dark headers or coloured rules across the page. Depth and grouping come from the grey ground, white panels and hairlines.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below 12px. The `2xs` step (12/16) is the smallest size in the scale.

rules.name: The Counted Figures Rule
rules.body: Dates, sizes, counts and percentages use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are near-black 13px medium, not coloured and not uppercase.

rules.name: The Bottom-Right Rule
rules.body: The primary action always sits at the bottom right of the step panel in the sticky footer. Back sits at the left; the attention jump sits in the centre.

rules.name: The Tabs Name It Rule
rules.body: When sub-step tabs are showing on desktop, the step title is visually hidden (kept for screen readers and phones) because the current tab already names the step.

rules.name: The Summary Only Rule
rules.body: A completed (read-only) module shows only its last step, a summary titled "What you submitted". Earlier step links redirect there, and no tabs show.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Box Rule
rules.body: Sections inside a step are divided by a hairline and 32px of space, never wrapped in bordered cards.

rules.name: The Translucent Chrome Rule
rules.body: Sticky bars (the header, the phone module bar) are white at 80 to 85% with a strong backdrop blur and a 6% black hairline, never a solid colour.

dos: Do keep every surface light: grouped grey ground, white panels, translucent white chrome.
Do use filled fields with the teal focus edge and halo; never outline fields at rest.
Do divide sections with hairlines and space; put items on soft 12px Field Fill tiles.
Do pair every status with an icon and a text label as well as its colour.
Do keep red for issues the provider has walked past and for HR rejections only (The Earned Red Rule).
Do show a completed module as its single "What you submitted" summary step.
Do keep the primary action at bottom right in the sticky footer.
Do use tabular numerals for every date, size, count and percentage.
donts: Don't add dark bands, dark headers or coloured rules across the page.
Don't box sections in bordered cards inside the step panel.
Don't colour a pending signature or untouched required work red; it is neutral work.
Don't give modules their own colours or put icons on tinted tiles.
Don't use the teal to mean approved; approval is the true green.
Don't set text in Progress Teal; use Clinical Teal for teal text.
Don't offer "Request changes" anywhere but the approved banner.
Don't copy the reference portal's logo, name or wording.
